_comment: Branch protection ruleset for the main branch. Applied via scripts/apply-ruleset.sh. Rules marked _staged:true represent target-state checks not yet ready to be managed from this checked-in config; apply-ruleset.sh and check-ruleset.yml filter them out of config-driven apply/drift checks for now, and any currently live rules of those staged types may be retained until the staged config is promoted.
name: Protect Main

rules._comment: Prevent force pushes to main — history must be linear and immutable.
Prevent direct deletion of the main branch.

Require a pull request before merging into main. required_approving_review_count:0 is intentional — the merge gate is the bot-review required status check (commit status set by the Code Reviewer Bot), not GitHub's formal approving-review count. require_code_owner_review:false is intentional — no CODEOWNERS file exists, so enabling this would have no effect and could create stuck PRs. dismiss_stale_reviews_on_push:true ensures the bot's APPROVE is dismissed on every new push, forcing re-review of each HEAD SHA (LS-3977).

STAGED DEPLOYMENT — DO NOT APPLY until prerequisites are met (design §3.7 two-step deploy): (1) ci-pipeline.yml is refactored to emit granular per-stage job names below, AND (2) those jobs are confirmed passing on several PRs. The contexts below are the TARGET names per design §9.1; they replace the current Quality Gates / Build Validation rollups. Applying before the CI refactor creates stuck 'Expected' required checks.
